 Crl.M.A.No.1 of 2023  in  Crl.Appeal No.59 of 2022  -----------------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 16th day of February, 2024  ORDER
This is a petition filed under Section 389(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
The appellant is the petitioner.

He stands convicted for the offences punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Rajesh vs State Of Kerala on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115862006/
1 Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 4 and 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (PoCSO Act).

sentences.text:
The longest period of imprisonment the petitioner has to undergo in terms of the sentence imposed is ten years under Section 5 r/w Section 6 of the PoCSO Act.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.
3.
The petitioner earlier filed Crl.M.A.No.1 of 2022 for the same relief.
That petition was dismissed as per the order dated 30.08.2022.

The petitioner would contend that since months elapsed after dismissal of the said petition and since there is no likelihood of hearing the appeal immediately, this Crl.M.A.No.1 of 2023 in petition for suspension of the sentence is liable to be considered.
Crl.M.A.No.1 of 2022 was dismissed on merits and after hearing both sides.
Other than the elapsing of a few months, there is no change in the circumstance.

4. The Apex Court in Saudan Singh vs The State Of Uttar Pradesh [(2021) SCC OnLine SC 3259]
held that when more than 50% of the term of sentence is undergone, the plea for suspension of sentence is liable to be considered favourably.

entities.text: Saudan Singh vs The State Of Uttar Pradesh [(2021) SCC OnLine SC 3259]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Hence, if 50% of the term of sentence is over, it could be a change in the circumstance entitling the petitioner to claim suspension of sentence.
In the absence of any such reason, this petition cannot be considered in the wake of dismissal of Crl.M.A.No.1 of 2022.
Hence, this petition is dismissed.

Sd/-
P.G. AJITHKUMAR, JUDGE dkr 16-02-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Rajesh vs State Of Kerala on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115862006/
